topic: Authoring, teaching, and verifying Strudel live-coding music patterns: REPL mechanics, Mini-Notation, sounds/banks, notes/scales, effects, signals, pattern stacks, canonical example tunes. Ground source: yubi-OS/yubiOS skills/strudel-live-coding/SKILL.md

subtopics.scope: What Strudel is: browser-based TidalCycles port to JavaScript, strudel.cc REPL, workshop ladder, uses (live coded music, teaching, MIDI/OSC sequencer), canonical home on Codeberg
REPL mechanics: Ctrl+Enter play/update, Ctrl+. stop, comments, $: parallel stacks, _$: muting, .hush() per-layer stop, on-demand sample loading
seed_queries: strudel REPL hush mute pattern stack $: first-sounds tutorial

subtopics.scope: Mini-Notation rhythm language: sequence, sample number, rest, alternate, subsequence, nesting, speed up, slow down, parallel, elongate, replicate; cycle-squish mental model
seed_queries: strudel mini-notation asterisk slash elongate replicate operators

subtopics.scope: Sounds, drums, banks: named unpitched samples, drum letter codes, .bank() drum machine swap list, s() alias for sound()
seed_queries: strudel sample number hh:0 bank switching drum machine

subtopics.scope: Notes, scales, tempo: MIDI numbers vs note letters, pitched sound choices, melodic slowing, scale degrees with .scale(), setcpm tempo math
seed_queries: strudel setcpm cycles per minute tempo default cycle seconds

subtopics.scope: Audio effects: lpf, vowel, gain, delay extended form, room, pan, speed, ADSR envelope, fast/slow outside Mini-Notation, patterning effects without changing rhythm
seed_queries: strudel pattern effect parameters mini notation filter tutorial

subtopics.scope: Signals (continuous modulation): sine/saw/square/tri/rand/perlin, 0-1 default range, .range() rescaling, .slow() modulation speed, .segment() discretization
seed_queries: strudel continuous pattern signals .range .slow modulation speed

subtopics.scope: Pattern effects (Tidal-specific toolbox): rev, jux, add, ply, off with transforms, multi-tempo .slow()
seed_queries: tidalcycles jux ply off pattern transformations strudel

subtopics.scope: Motors and beyond audio: patterning hardware via MQTT, move/motor/robot, servo ranges, .segment() limits for microcontrollers
seed_queries: strudel hardware pattern Pimoroni Inventor 2040W servo

subtopics.scope: Canonical full tunes (verified workshop examples) plus the build-from-scratch teaching path and verify/debug checklist
